name: superman row with towel
description: Lie face down with a towel held taut overhead, lift your chest and pull the towel toward you, training the upper back and spine.
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead, holding a towel taut.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Pull the towel down toward your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Extend your arms forward again with control.
Keep your neck neutral and repeat.
